content: उद्घट् <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To open; द्वारे पुरस्योद्घटितापिधाने <ls>Ku. 7. 53</ls>. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (-घाटयति) .²1 To open, unlock; निरयनगरद्वारमुद्घाटयन्ती <ls>Bh. 1. 63</ls>; कपाटमुद्घाटयामि <ls>Mk. 3</ls>. .²2 To peel off, shell. .²3 To reveal, expose, make known. .²4 To undertake, commence. .²5 To rub over, stroke gently, tickle.
